The big feature drop.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Secure notes** — locked behind a passkey, blurred until unlocked.
- **Search inside images and audio** — local OCR (Tesseract) and transcription (Whisper).
- **Time machine** — scrub through a note's past versions.
- **SSO** — sign in with OpenID Connect.

### 🚀 Features
- Ghost-card backlinks, a contents bar and focus mode.
- Activity heatmap and rule-based smart collections.
- Drag-and-drop import of `.md` / `.txt`, and git sync.
- Read-it-later web archiver and signed webhooks.
- Encrypted backups you can restore.
- API keys (`X-API-Key`) and a docs portal.
- Local AI search and chat with Ollama.
- New editor, with ordering, sharing, categories and to-dos.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.0.1...v0.1.0](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.0.1...v0.1.0)
